scripts.build:js: tsc -p js/tsconfig.json && cp js/package.json js/dist/package.json && cp js/src/index.mjs js/dist/index.mjs && cp README.md js/dist/README.md && cp LICENSE js/dist/LICENSE && chmod +x js/dist/bin/sass.js
scripts.mirror-src-pkg: rm -rf js/src/pkg-sync js/src/pkg-async js/src/pkg-web && cp -r js/dist/pkg-sync js/src/pkg-sync && cp -r js/dist/pkg-async js/src/pkg-async && cp -r js/dist/pkg-web js/src/pkg-web
scripts.build:rust: rm -rf pkg js/dist/pkg-sync && mkdir -p js/dist && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --features glibc-math && mv pkg js/dist/pkg-sync && rm -rf pkg js/dist/pkg-async && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --features async,glibc-math && mv pkg js/dist/pkg-async && rm -rf pkg js/dist/pkg-web && wasm-pack build --target web --features glibc-math && mv pkg js/dist/pkg-web && npm run strip-pkg-meta && npm run mirror-src-pkg
scripts.build:rust:release: rm -rf pkg js/dist/pkg-sync && mkdir -p js/dist && wasm-pack build --release --target nodejs --features glibc-math && mv pkg js/dist/pkg-sync && rm -rf pkg js/dist/pkg-async && wasm-pack build --release --target nodejs --features async,glibc-math && mv pkg js/dist/pkg-async && rm -rf pkg js/dist/pkg-web && wasm-pack build --release --target web --features glibc-math && mv pkg js/dist/pkg-web && npm run strip-pkg-meta && npm run mirror-src-pkg
scripts.build:playground: mkdir -p playground && cp js/dist/pkg-web/rust_sass_wasm.js js/dist/pkg-web/rust_sass_wasm_bg.wasm playground/
scripts.strip-pkg-meta: for d in pkg-sync pkg-async pkg-web; do rm -f js/dist/$d/package.json js/dist/$d/.gitignore js/dist/$d/README.md js/dist/$d/LICENSE; done
scripts.build:playground:release: npm run build:rust:release && npm run build:playground
scripts.playground: npm run build:playground && npx serve playground
